import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
OUTPUT_DIR = "./submission"
OUTPUT_PATH = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Load data
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

# Identify feature columns dynamically
feature_cols = [
    col for col in df_train.columns if col.startswith(("margin", "shape", "texture"))
]

# Prepare features and targets
X = df_train[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
y_raw = df_train["species"].values
X_test = df_test[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
test_ids = df_test["id"].values

# Encode labels to integers
le = LabelEncoder()
y_enc = le.fit_transform(y_raw)
classes = le.classes_

# Strict 80/20 stratified split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y_enc, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_enc
)

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Model parameters (standard baseline configuration)
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(classes),
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "min_child_samples": 10,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Train with early stopping on validation set
print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=2000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Compute validation multi-class log-loss (hold-out estimate)
val_probs = model.predict(X_val)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs, labels=range(len(classes)))
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log-Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_probs = model.predict(X_test)

# Align probabilities with sample submission classes
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=classes)
sub_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)

# Ensure column order exactly matches the sample template
sub_df = sub_df[sample_sub.columns]

# Save submission
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
sub_df.to_csv(OUTPUT_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")
